messages.subject: conditionalPanel does not work for numerical binary comparisons
parts:
Hi all,
With the upgrade to version 0.4.0 the conditionalPanel, which once was working fine, stopped doing the job. What I want is to have a slider hide/show depending on a numeric input. The relevant code chunk in my ui.R is below: 

shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
  
 headerPanel("Distribution of squared sums of wavelet and scaling coefficients."),
 sidebarPanel(
    numericInput(inputId = "nbreaks",
                label = "Number of breaks:", value = 0, min=0,max=6,
                step=1),
    conditionalPanel(condition= "input.nbreaks==1",
                     sliderInput(inputId = "loc1",
                                 label = "Location of 1st break",
                                 min = 0.0, max = 1, value = .5, step = 0.01)
                    ),
...
))

Can someone help with this?

HI,

I would like to narrow (at least my point) it down:

I am working still on a local installation (not shiny-.server), which does not react on out.variables in the conditionalPanel anymore

To clarify my issue have a look in the code:

ui.R: (partial)
  sidebarPanel(
    
    conditionalPanel(
      condition = "output.accesslevel != 'member' & output.accesslevel != 'guest'",
      textInput("U_Nummer","u-Nummer:",""),
      textInput("Password","Password:",""),
      helpText ("The application is access restricted. It is still experimental. Please use as user and password 'member' or 'guest'.")
    ),

server.R (partial)
 output$accesslevel <- reactive({
    print ("server: accesslevel")
    access_user <- subset (access,U_Nummer == input$U_Nummer)
    NA
    print (access_user)
    
    if (access_user$Password == input$Password) {
      access_user$Role
      print (access_user$Role)
    }
  })

On the R console you do not get any output (print...) from this piece of code. I have the impression, that server.R does not react. (This was different in shiny 0.30). Excluding this condition the application works fine.

Does anybody see the problem?

Thank you in advance, Jürgen

PS: The conditionalPanel works with (numeric) input.variables in my case.

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: conditionalPanel does not work for numerical binary comparisons
parts:
Shiny 0.4.1 (I believe) introduced a feature where outputs that do not visibly appear in the page are not calculated by default. This is often desirable, e.g. when an expensive-to-compute plot is contained in a tab that is not currently selected.

You can get around this behavior by adding this line right after assigning output$accesslevel:

outputOptions(output, "accesslevel", suspendWhenHidden=FALSE)

However, I cannot explain why Harun's input-based condition does not work.
